result.instructions: Tools for Sociocs, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which customers sent us a message in the last 90 days and have not had a reply?"; "Find the contact for +16175551212 and show the messages we exchanged this month."; "List our Twilio SMS channels and their phone numbers.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sociocs data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sociocs_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sociocs_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sociocs_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sociocs_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sociocs_list_channels
tools.title: List channels
tools.description: List the sending channels (phone numbers) for one provider, with their channel_key. Use it first to find the channel_key that sociocs_send_message needs. Sociocs API: GET /channels.

provider.description: Messaging provider: tlnx (Telnyx SMS), twlo (Twilio SMS), twlowa (Twilio WhatsApp), gswa (Gupshup WhatsApp).

tools.name: sociocs_get_channel
tools.title: Get a channel
tools.description: Get one channel by its channel_key: name, phone number, country code and provider. Sociocs API: GET /channels/{channel_key}.

tools.name: sociocs_list_contact_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List all contact lists with their ids. Use an id as list_id in sociocs_list_contacts. Sociocs API: GET /lists.

tools.name: sociocs_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts from 'All Contacts' (list_id 0, the default) or from one contact list. Sociocs API: GET /contacts.

list_id.description: 0 for All Contacts (default), or a contact list id.

tools.name: sociocs_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Search contacts by part of a name or a phone number (case insensitive, at least 2 characters). Sociocs API: GET /contacts/search.

query.description: Part of the name or phone number.

tools.name: sociocs_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact by phone number, with the country code (with or without the leading plus). Sociocs API: GET /contacts/{phone_number}.

phone_number.description: Phone number with country code, e.g. +16175551212.

tools.name: sociocs_list_messages
tools.title: List messages by date
tools.description: List all messages between start_date and end_date (inclusive; at most 31 days apart; default today). Sociocs API: GET /messages.

tools.name: sociocs_search_messages
tools.title: Search messages
tools.description: Search message text. Filter by direction (incoming, outbound or both; default both) and dates (default: the last 90 days). Sociocs API: GET /messages/search.

tools.name: sociocs_list_unreplied_messages
tools.title: List unreplied messages
tools.description: List incoming messages that have no reply, from the last 90 days by default. Good for finding customers who are waiting. Sociocs API: GET /messages/unreplied.

tools.name: sociocs_list_scheduled_messages
tools.title: List scheduled messages
tools.description: List up to 100 scheduled messages, newest scheduled date first. There is no pagination. Sociocs API: GET /messages/scheduled.

tools.name: sociocs_list_bulk_jobs
tools.title: List bulk messaging jobs
tools.description: List up to 100 bulk messaging jobs, newest scheduled date first. There is no pagination. Sociocs API: GET /messages/bulk.

tools.name: sociocs_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List the team members of the account with their user ids (use one as user_id in sociocs_send_message). Sociocs API: GET /team-members.

tools.name: sociocs_list_webhook_subscriptions
tools.title: List webhook subscriptions
tools.description: List the webhook subscriptions (endpoints that receive incoming messages or status updates). Sociocs API: GET /webhook-subscriptions.

tools.name: sociocs_send_message
tools.title: Send a message
tools.description: SENDS a real SMS or WhatsApp message to a real phone number, now or at a future schedule time. Not reversible. Give at least one of text, image_url, video_url or file_url. WhatsApp messages outside the 24-hour window need a template, which this tool does not send. Sociocs API: POST /message.

provider.description: Provider: gswa (Gupshup WhatsApp), sh (Signal House SMS), tlnx (Telnyx SMS), twlo (Twilio SMS), twlowa (Twilio WhatsApp).

to.description: Recipient phone number with country code, e.g. +16175551212.

schedule.description: ISO 8601 date and time for a future send, e.g. 2026-12-01T09:00:00+01:00. Omit to send now.

user_id.description: Team member id shown as the sender (from sociocs_list_team_members).

tools.name: sociocs_delete_scheduled_message
tools.title: Delete a scheduled message
tools.description: Delete a scheduled message that has not been sent yet. A message that is already sending or sent cannot be deleted. Sociocs API: DELETE /messages/scheduled/{message_id}.

prompts.title: Get started with Sociocs
prompts.description: What you can do with Sociocs here, with example requests to try.
